title: Book 6 — Erato, Chapter 99
paragraphs: Having left Delos, the barbarians put in at the islands along the way, gathering additional forces and taking the islanders' sons as hostages. Sailing round them in turn, they also came to Carystos. The Carystians, however, would neither give them hostages nor agree to join an expedition against their neighbors — meaning Eretria and Athens — so the Persians began to besiege the town and ravage its territory, until in the end the Carystians too gave way and came over to the king's side.
